scoring.basis: Five spread-only SuperContest picks at their frozen contest lines

weeks.source: dist/locked-card-week-1.json; reports/bets/season-recap/week1-post-mortem.html; reports/bets/season-recap/w1gamesum.json; saved ESPN box scores
weeks.note: The frozen Week 1 Dashboard card was recovered from dist/locked-card-week-1.json and graded against completed ESPN box scores. It is the same five spread selections as the saved official card.
weeks.review: Both frozen five-side cards went 1–4 (1 point). PIT -3.5 covered by 3.5 points; TB +3.5, IND +3.5, DAL -3, and CAR +3 failed to cover. Dallas lost 28–20 to the Giants, so DAL -3 is graded as a loss rather than left ungraded.
weeks.dashboard_why: The Dashboard five was TB +3.5, IND +3.5, PIT -3.5, DAL -3, and CAR +3. Only PIT covered. The underdog selections TB, IND, and CAR lost by 6, 18, and 22; DAL lost outright by 8. The saved results establish the score, while these outcomes show the card leaned too heavily on underdog sides and a Dallas favorite that lost outright.
weeks.amanda_why: Amanda's official five matched the saved Dashboard card. PIT -3.5 was the only winner; TB +3.5, IND +3.5, DAL -3, and CAR +3 lost. Dallas's completed 20–28 loss to the Giants makes DAL -3 a graded loss, bringing the official Week 1 card to 1–4 (1 point).

weeks.review: Dashboard side set went 3-2; MIN, DEN and NYJ covered. MIA and WAS lost by 22 and 17. Our official card went 2-3, losing LAC outright plus WAS and MIA; it retained the winning DEN and LAR sides.
weeks.dashboard_why: MIA +13.5 and WAS +4.5 were the two misses, losing by 22 and 17 points; MIN +5.5, DEN -2.5 and NYJ +3.5 covered.
weeks.amanda_why: LAC -6.5 lost outright, and WAS +4 and MIA +14 failed to cover. DEN -2.5 and LAR -6.5 were the two winners.

weeks.review: Both cards went 1-4. NYG beat TEN by 5, DET beat NYJ by 7 (the AI side missed by half a point), CIN lost outright, and SF won by only 6. JAX -3 was the lone winner on both. The PHI substitution also lost outright.
weeks.dashboard_why: The misses were TEN +2.5 (NYG won by 5), NYJ +6.5 (DET won by 7, a half-point ATS miss), CIN -3.5 (lost outright), and SF -8.5 (won by only 6). JAX -3 was the lone winner.
weeks.amanda_why: TEN +2.5, PHI -4.5, CIN -3.5 and SF -8.5 missed; NYG beat TEN by 5, PHI and CIN lost outright, and SF won by only 6. JAX -3 was the only winner.

weeks.review: Both cards missed ARI. Dashboard also missed DEN +2.5; the official card took SF -2.5 instead, which covered. The other three picks won on both cards.
weeks.dashboard_why: ARI -2.5 lost and DEN +2.5 did not cover; MIA +9.5, LAR -3.5 and TEN +11.5 covered.
weeks.amanda_why: ARI -1.5 was the only miss. SF -2.5, MIA +10.5, LAR -3 and TEN +11.5 covered.

weeks.review: Pick-by-pick regrade corrected the earlier summary: Dashboard scored 3-2 because BAL +3.5 covered, while our reconstructed official five scored 0-4-1, with CIN -7 pushing and the other four missing. The Dashboard set was the dated card proposal, not a placed ticket.
weeks.dashboard_why: TEN +7.5 and LAC +3.5 failed to cover; GB +3, PIT -2.5 and BAL +3.5 covered. Baltimore won outright 30-23 at Atlanta, so BAL +3.5 was a clear winner.
weeks.amanda_why: ARI +5.5, ATL -3.5, LV +3.5 and NO +2.5 missed. CIN -7 pushed; there were no winning selections in the saved five. Atlanta lost outright 30-23 to Baltimore, so ATL -3.5 did not cover.

weeks.review: The revised Dashboard five scored 3.0; the official five scored 4.0. CAR, CLE and GB were shared winners. The official card's KC side covered; SF -7.5 was its only miss. Dashboard ATL +3 and JAX -2.5 missed: CHI led ATL 31-7 before late scores, with ATL committing three turnovers, and HOU beat JAX 34-31 after a late go-ahead field goal. JAX's original projection used an unbacktested margin blend and the report flagged gusts.
weeks.dashboard_why: ATL +3 and JAX -2.5 were the misses. Chicago led Atlanta 31–7 before late scores and Atlanta committed three turnovers; Houston beat Jacksonville 34–31 on a late go-ahead field goal. JAX's original projection used an unbacktested margin blend and the report had flagged gusts. CAR, CLE and GB covered.
weeks.amanda_why: SF -7.5 was the lone miss. CAR, CLE, KC and GB covered; KC was the official-card difference versus the AI set.

weeks.note: No final score until all games are complete and Andy and Amanda confirm the official five. Freeze the Dashboard five and contest lines before kickoff.
